input.question: What is the historical name of Biu?

documents.text: Biu lies on the Biu Plateau at an average elevation of 626 meters . [ 1 ] The region is semi-arid . [ 2 ] History [ edit ] The name of Biu was initially called Viu which in Babur and Bura Language means high . The Biu kingdom became established around 1670 in the reign of Mari Watila Tampta . King Mari Watirwa ( r. 1793–1838 ) , whose capital was near Biu at Kogu , defeated Fulani invaders from the Gombe Emirate to the west . In 1878 Mari Biya , became the first Babur king to rule
